fathersHeart.title: You Cannot be Both Popular and Powerful
paragraphs: There is a battle between popularity and power. You cannot be popular and powerful at the same time. You must decide which one you want, and choose whether you want to be powerful with God or popular with men. A church service is not successful because people came; a church service is successful because what God wants done was done. Until you begin to see that, you are going to be criss-crossing strange emotions.
John 8:29
29 And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

There will be men that want you to please them, and then there is a God that has called you to please Him. That Jesus was popular as a minister does not mean this has to be your goal.  This error is how the devil has gotten many men of God on the popular craze. If you are judging whether your ministry is successful by how popular it is, you will soon become a false prophet. To serve God, you may have to say many unpopular things. As your ministry begins to grow, you are going to come against that devil that wants you to prioritise pleasing men to pleasing God.

It is easier to please God when you are small and unknown than when your ministry begins to have some results and then some people that are not looking for God show up for your soul. There are many Christian leaders that in their closet, their soul has been possessed by the devil. They know it, God knows it and the devil knows it, but people yet do not know it.

Choosing to please men over pleasing God is what makes a true prophet to become a soothsayer. As a man of God, when you become popular, will you be bold to say something unpopular even when God is saying it? Not everyone that started with His commitment sustained it to the end, and it is on this point where there comes a contest between popularity with men and power with God that many fail. When the approval of God and the applause of men confront you, it is going to be a serious matter. There are ministries that have been built on the philosophy of popularity and as a person with a genuine call of God on your life, you must decide what you are going to build your life and assignment on. Everybody can come to your church except God, but the truth is that if God comes, He will bring the people He wants.
fathersHeart.quote: There is a battle between popularity and power. You cannot be popular and powerful at the same time. You must decide which one you want, and choose whether you want to be powerful with God or popular with men.
fathersHeart.closing: Till next week, go and win with Jesus.

blocks.h: The Fight Between Faith and Feelings

blocks.p: In the fight of faith, the believer is not fighting the devil but feelings and thoughts. Once he can stop responding to negative feelings and thoughts, he will control what the devil does. The devil comes through feelings, thoughts, and imaginations, but the believer must never act on them. In dealing with darkness, believers must know there are: the person of darkness, the power of darkness and the presence of darkness. Jesus has defeated the person of darkness (the devil), but he is still free to roam on this planet until the lease he stole from Adam runs out. As the Church, we have been delivered from the power of darkness, but we have not been delivered from the presence of darkness.

blocks.scripture: Psalm 23:4 Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

blocks.p: You must ensure that you do not put yourself in the grip of the power of darkness by walking by sight. In Mark 11, when Jesus cursed the fig tree, He did not respond to the symptoms anymore, but the disciples continued to and they lost the fight of faith.

blocks.scripture: Mark 11:12–22. 12 And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry: 13 And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet. 14 And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it. 15 And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves; 16 And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple. 17 And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves. 18 And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine. 19 And when even was come, he went out of the city. 20 And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots. 21 And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away. 22 And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

blocks.p: In Mark 9, when He delivered the epileptic child, the disciples kept looking at the manifestation and lost that battle. The demon did the same manifestation before Jesus, but He did not respond and He won that battle.

blocks.scripture: Mark 9:20, 25–27. 20 And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming. 25  When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him. 26 And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead;  insomuch that many said, He is dead. 27 But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

blocks.p: On the sea in Mat. 14 when Jesus walked on water, Peter was looking at the wind and lost the battle, but the Master did not.

blocks.scripture: Mathew 14:26–31. 26 And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear. 27 But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid. 28 And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water. 29 And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus. 30 But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me. 31 And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

blocks.p: You need to know that as soon as you act on the word of God, the power of God goes into operation spiritually. As soon as the word of God is released over a case, the power of God is connected, hence you must not abort it. Once you understand that, you are on the way to victory. Sometimes, some matters take one year to fully manifest while some take a day. Sometimes, it takes ten years, but the believer must not change what he said at the start. You should act like God’s power has gone into operation regardless of how you feel or how it looks. When Jesus spoke to the boy with epilepsy, the demon tore the boy as if he was going to kill him; he fell as if he was dead, but Jesus lifted him. As a Christian, handle lack of evidence and contradictory evidence correctly and you will never lose a battle of faith.

paragraphs: Good evening Mummy,
Up Holy Ghost!
JESUS IS REAL!
GOD IS FAITHFUL!
Mummy, thank you so much to You and Daddy for the privilege to serve in church, especially among the teenagers.
I have a testimony. I was called to resume as a full-time Lecturer at a private university yesterday with a monthly salary of over #300k and other packages.
What surprised me is that during the interview, I was the only applicant in my faculty who didn't graduate from the university. I already concluded they wouldn't pick me.

In the first phase, the panel changed the topic I prepared and asked me to teach a different one on the spot. I was destabilised and didn't do very well, so I thought I wouldn't make it to the next phase, but they still called me.
In the next phase, I found favour before the VC and his Deputy - they were even helping me answer some questions.

Then they asked if I could help make their students godly if given the job, and how I would do it. I started sharing little tips I learned from serving in the Teenagers Church. Immediately they asked me where I worship and where I serve in church. When I said Dream Centre, Teenagers Church, they all responded excitedly that I am the person they need.
Mummy, I can boldly say I got this job because of my assignment in church. What I do in church was exactly what they were looking for and not only academic qualifications.
Thank you always Daddy
Thank you always Mummy.
THANK YOU JESUS!!!

honour.title: Our month of the Double Portions

word.title: The Month of of the Double Portions

blocks.lead: I heard this morning in my heart - welcome to the month of DOUBLE BLESSINGS!

blocks.p: I don’t fully know what it means but I went to study the double in the bible. Let me welcome you into the followings:
Genesis 41:32 - Double dreams and double Holy Spirit experiences for you.
"And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass."
Genesis 43:12 & 15 - Double incomes.
Genesis 43:12 (KJV)
"And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:"
Genesis 43:15 (KJV)
"And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph."
Exodus 22:4, 7, 9 - Double restorations of stolen things.
Exodus 22:4 (KJV)
"If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double."
Exodus 22:7 (KJV)
"If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double."
Exodus 22:9 (KJV)

"For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour."
Deuteronomy 21:17 - Double portions.
"But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated for the firstborn, by giving him a double portion of all that he hath: for he is the beginning of his strength; the right of the firstborn is his."
2 Kings 2:9 - Double impartations of grace where you have served.

"And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me."
Isaiah 61:7 - Double blessings for all your troubles.
"For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them."
Jeremiah 17:18 - Double destruction to your enemies.
"Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction."
Zechariah 9:11 - Double rewards.
"As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water."
1 Timothy 5:17 - Double honours to all our pastors and shepherds who have laboured well.
"Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine."
Therefore, beloved of the Lord, I welcome you into this special door of DOUBLE BLESSINGS.
May every good thing come your way doubled this month in Jesus name.
The doubled blessings is your portion in life. Step into it by faith now.
Forever His,
Rev Olusola Ayodele Areogun
